title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF provided education to 155,811 crisis-affected children (69,906 girls), rehabilitated 105 classrooms, and strengthened management in 211 schools across Somalia. These actions broke gender and crisis-related barriers, ensuring safer, inclusive learning environments and expanding equitable access to both formal and non-formal education
